messages:
Hana Park: Quick design thread: tooltips show mixed formats (1.2K vs 1,234). Confusing for support folks.
Diego Morales: Yeah, formatter reuse causes that. We should standardize.
Renee Carter: Proposal: tooltip primary = full value with separators, secondary muted line = compact unit + metric name. Keeps clarity and low footprint.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: screen readers must get a full-word aria label (e.g., 'one thousand two hundred thirty-four requests per minute').
Hana Park: For tiny sparklines show only compact and add a focusable "expand" affordance that reveals full number.
Diego Morales: Also add a per-chart "Clamp extremes" toggle in the header. When enabled show a small legend badge that reads 'clamped' and a tooltip: 'Extreme values trimmed to highlight trends. Hover for raw values.' Emit an annotation when clipping occurs.
Renee Carter: Visual tweak: increase gridline contrast token (light: #D0D7DE, dark token mapped) and bold major gridlines slightly.
Hana Park: Acceptance criteria for RFC: (1) tooltip shows full + muted compact by default on regular charts, (2) sparklines compact + expandable, (3) clamp toggle + badge + annotation, (4) aria-label reads full value in words, (5) gridline token PR.
Diego Morales: I'll draft RFC and mockups. ETA EOD.
Renee Carter: I'll handle keyboard focus and aria copy.
Hana Park: Thanks! :thumbsup:
